title: Selling Continues.. Stocks, Bonds, Oil, Geopolitics... the ELECTION
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: His 5.27% top call on the 10-year has held; yields now ~5.08% and he hopes they stay below it despite hot CPI/PPI.
Oil ~105 is an expensive level; energy is driving most of the PPI/CPI increases.
Expects a US-Iran deal between Oct 20-27; without one, a Democratic sweep is almost certain, with a deal a split Congress is likely.
A Democratic sweep (no Iran deal) would be a tailwind for renewables; 'time to buy some solar plays again'.
Hardware and AI-infrastructure names (e.g. CoreWeave) are getting hit; political backlash may delay but not stop data-center buildout.

calls.reason: Restates his call that ~5.27% was the top in the 10-year yield (plus or minus 5 bps); yield has fallen ~20 bps since.
calls.quote: I am confident that this is the top on the 10-year, and it was.

calls.reason: QQQ lost 725 at the open; notes it is not near the 715 line, which is good. Levels only, no directional call.
calls.quote: we have the queues losing 725. Now, we are not nowhere near the 715 line, which is good.

notes: No date spoken; listing approx_date 2026-10-17 is a Saturday but this is a live market-hours stream (mentions 'yesterday' PPI), so actual date is likely Fri 2026-10-16. TNX invalidation 5.32 inferred from his 'plus or minus five basis points' around 5.27. Solar 'buy' is conditional on no Iran deal and names no ticker, so kept in macro_themes only. Oil (~105) and gold mentioned without a bias.
